key_insight: HemOncAgent is an AI retrieval system that dynamically chooses between structured and narrative oncology sources to answer treatment questions more reliably.
clinical_relevance: For oncology knowledge lookup, a hybrid tool-based approach may better support clinicians by combining database facts with care-pathway context.
method: Selects among retrieval tools in the HemOnc knowledge ecosystem.
Uses HemOncKB for curated pharmacologic relationships.
Uses HemOnc.org for clinician-authored narrative treatment pathways.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong retrieval performance across structured and narrative benchmarks, with single-source systems showing domain-specific limitations.
watch_item: Performance appears benchmark-based, so real-world clinical use will depend on source quality, update frequency, and safe integration into workflows.
paper_title: HemOncAgent: an artificial intelligence system for retrieving structured and narrative oncology knowledge
